context: Daichi accompanies Sho to his first sports league game.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、今日、初めての試合、頑張れな。
lines.en: Sho — today's your first game. You've got this.
lines.style: Warm, Kansai-tinged encouragement with real affection underneath. Bright opening attack on his name. Steady conviction without pressure. The tone of someone who believes in you without needing to say it twice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, honest voice. Quiet admission without dramatising it. Soft warmth in his sincerity. The kind of vulnerability only safe people get to hear from a six-year-old.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: I'll be cheering for you the whole time, promise.
lines.style: Kansai lilt with absolute certainty woven through. Warm, protective reassurance. Lands the promise without overselling it — just stating fact with a smile audible in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: If you're there, I feel brave.
lines.style: Tender, small-voiced trust. Slow, unhurried pace. Not asking for much — just naming what's true. Soft trailing warmth at the end, like he's said something important and knows it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: It's going to be fun — you'll see.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with a gentle promise threaded through. Closing attack with quiet certainty. Soft, genuine smile in the voice. The tone of someone painting a picture he believes in.
